transcripts.onepager_promise: Drafts answers to supplier questions from the published RFQ pack, and routes anything new to a clarification every bidder sees
transcripts.prompt: A bidder on the transformer RFQ asks if they can deliver all 24 units in two lots instead of three. What should I tell them?
transcripts.assistant_response:
The RFQ requires three lots of 8 units to Central Stores, so the bidder can't change that in their compliant bid. Lot dates are set at award from each bidder's quoted lead time.

The published terms do allow a different lot plan as a **variant bid under section 5.3**, but only alongside a compliant three-lot bid. So you can tell them:

> "The RFQ specifies 24 units in three lots of 8 to Central Stores. You may submit a two-lot delivery plan as a variant bid under section 5.3, but it must accompany a compliant three-lot bid. Lot dates are set at award from your quoted lead time."

This answer is already in the published RFQ pack, so sending it doesn't give this bidder any advantage over others. The draft is ready in the supplier portal but hasn't been sent. You need to approve and send it there.

The RFQ closes 05 Nov 2026, in 6 days.

transcripts.onepager_promise: Scores every bid on price, lead time, quality and sustainability and explains the ranked recommendation for the award panel
transcripts.prompt: The transformer bids are in. How do they score, and who should the award panel pick?
transcripts.assistant_response:
**Brightwater Transformers** scores highest, at 96.2 of 100, and is the recommended award at **$648,000**. The award panel makes the final decision. No supplier has been told the outcome.

| Rank | Supplier | Price | Lead time | Quality | Sustainability | Score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Brightwater Transformers | $648,000 | 9 weeks | Complete | 9/10 | **96.2** |
| 2 | Halden Transformer Works | $630,000 | 10 weeks | Complete | 6/10 | **92.6** |
| 3 | Kelso Electrical Supply | $612,000 | 13 weeks | Incomplete | 2/10 | **75.8** |

Weights are price 50, lead time 20, quality 20, sustainability 10.

- **Brightwater** leads on lead time, complete documents, and sustainability (an environmental product declaration and 30% recycled core steel). It is $18,000 more than Halden, but Halden's lower price doesn't offset its slower delivery and weaker sustainability score.
- **Kelso** is the cheapest, but its type test certificate for the offered design is missing and its lead time is 13 weeks. The panel should treat that as a compliance gap, not just a score.
